{{Nihongo|'''Kimito Funatsu'''|船津 公人|Funatsu Kimito|born December 3, 1955}}<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://funatsu.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/ja/member-ja/professor-page-ja/ |title=東京大学化学システム工学専攻船津研究室 − 船津公人教授 (in Japanese) |access-date=5 October 2021 |archive-date=9 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210909174105/http://funatsu.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/ja/member-ja/professor-page-ja/ |url-status=bot: unknown }}</ref> is a Japanese chemist specializing in [[Cheminformatics|chemoinformatics]] and data-driven chemistry, a professor emeritus at [[University of Tokyo]], and the research director of the Data Science Center at [[Nara Institute of Science and Technology]].

== Biography ==
He graduated from [[Kagoshima Prefectural Konan High School]] in 1974<ref>{{cite book |editor=「甲南塾」 企画委員会 |date=March 2006 |title=甲南新書 第五集 |language=Japanese |location=Japan |publisher=鹿児島県立甲南高等学校 }}</ref> and from Department of Chemistry, School of Science, [[Kyushu University]] in 1978.<ref name=UT>{{Cite web |url=https://www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/content/400154634.pdf |title=東京大学 令和2年度退職教員の紹介 大学院工学研究科 船津公人教授 |language=Japanese |publisher=東京大学 (University of Tokyo) |accessdate=2021-10-05}}</ref> He completed Department of Chemistry, Graduate School of Science, Kyushu University and obtained a doctorate in science in 1983.{{R|UT}} After he served as an associate professor at [[Toyohashi University of Technology]], he became a professor at Department of Chemical System Engineering, School of Engineering, [[University of Tokyo]] in 2004.{{R|UT}} He concurrently holds the posts of a professor and the research director of the Data Science Center at [[Nara Institute of Science and Technology]] from 2017.{{R|UT}} He was also invited as visiting professor at [[University of Strasbourg]] in France in 2011.{{R|UT}}

The Division of Chemical Information of the [[American Chemical Society]] gave him the [[Herman Skolnik Award]] in 2019 for his contributions to structure elucidation, de novo structure generation and applications of cheminformatics methods to materials design and chemical process control.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.acscinf.org/awards/the-skolnik-award |title=The Herman Skolnik Award |website=acscinf.org |publisher=American Chemical Society Division of Chemical Information |access-date=2021-10-05 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.chemistry.or.jp/news/information/2019-herman-skolnik-award.html |title=【お知らせ】2019 Herman Skolnik Awardを船津公人教授が受賞 |date=2018-10-16 |website=日本化学会 |language=Japanese |publisher=日本化学会（The Chemical Society of Japan) |access-date=2021-10-05 }}</ref> He also received the {{Nihongo|[[Chemical Society of Japan|Chemical Society of Japan Award for Creative Work]]|日本化学会 学術賞||}} for 2020.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.chemistry.or.jp/news/information/2020-8.html |title=【お知らせ】2020年度各賞受賞者が決定 |date=2021-01-07 |website=日本化学会 |language=Japanese |publisher=日本化学会（The Chemical Society of Japan） |access-date=2021-10-05 }}</ref> In 2021, he retired from University of Tokyo at mandatory age<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://funatsu.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/ja/%e3%83%9b%e3%83%bc%e3%83%a0/ |title=東京大学化学システム工学専攻船津研究室 − ホーム「船津公人教授の定年退職について」 (in Japanese) |access-date=5 October 2021 |archive-date=9 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210909174256/http://funatsu.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/ja/%e3%83%9b%e3%83%bc%e3%83%a0/ |url-status=bot: unknown }}</ref> and was given the title of professor emeritus.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/content/400154634.pdf |title=令和３年度 東京大学名誉教授 |language=Japanese |publisher=東京大学 (University of Tokyo) |page=1 |accessdate=2021-10-05}}</ref>
